expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.m1===10 && S.m2===2 && S.r===4 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: m1 = 10 t, m2 = 2 t, r = 4,0 m (must run before any setup)

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return R.length===3 && R[0].min==='1' && R[0].max==='10' && R[0].step==='1' && R[1].min==='1' && R[1].max==='10' && R[2].min==='2' && R[2].max==='10' && R[2].step==='0.5' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three sliders: m1 and m2 1-10 t step 1, r 2-10 m step 0,5

expr: (() => { const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root button')].map(x=>x.textContent); const k=[...document.getElementById('sim-root').children].map(e=>e.tagName==='CANVAS'?'canvas':e.className); return b[0]==='Tyhjennä kuvaaja' && k.indexOf('canvas')<k.indexOf('controls') && k.indexOf('controls')<k.indexOf('readout') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: main button first; DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='m1,m2,r' && P.m1.unit==='t' && P.m2.unit==='t' && P.r.unit==='m' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares m1 (t), m2 (t) and r (m)
